name: GitAhead
description: Auto-downloads+installs the installer with no hash/sig; a user Ignore of SSL errors persists as a bypass.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: GitAhead’s updater helper uses Qt’s NoLessSafeRedirectPolicy and reports network errors. The original assertions about persistent TLS exceptions and the complete artifact-verification policy remain unsubstantiated by this bounded source review.
